persona.product_mechanics: Ingests continuous biometric and activity telemetry from wearables, diagnostic lab results, and daily check-ins to run predictive risk scoring and aging assessments via an analytics engine (ALIVE O.S.). Dispatches personalized recommendations, meal recognition analyses, and micro-actions to users and dedicated human coaches through a mobile application.
persona.customers: Consumers/individuals, corporate employers, health insurers, clinical providers, pharma companies, and public health systems.
scale_signals: 10+ years of longitudinal biometric and behavior telemetry

spec.project_context: ALIVE O.S. — the health-telemetry risk-scoring engine: ingest biometric/activity telemetry, compute auditable risk scores and aging assessments, dispatch recommendations and coach alerts.

plan.invariant: a member's risk score reflects the newest event-time reading and never regresses when a late, older-event-time sample arrives; alert dispatch is at-most-once per recipient on a stable event id
plan.summary: ALIVE O.S. health-telemetry risk-scoring engine — layered core/store/services/worker/api, deterministic and in-memory, with debug (as-of regression), feature (idempotent dispatch), and design (scale) tasks.
